# capi_provider_components (Data Source)

The components of a CAPI provider release, fetched exactly as `clusterctl init` would fetch them (pinned `version`, `fetch_config`, the clusterctl config file and environment all apply), and the kinds its CRDs serve. With literal inputs it is read at plan time, so objects of the provider (`capi_machine_template`, `capi_object`) can name their `api_version` and `kind` from `kinds` and render completely on the first plan, before any cluster exists.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The kinds and API versions a provider release ships, to name `api_version`
# on templates and objects so they render completely at plan.
data "capi_provider_components" "tinkerbell" {
  type         = "infrastructure"
  name         = "tinkerbell"
  version      = "v0.7.9"
  fetch_config = { owner = "tinkerbell-community" }
}

output "machine_template_api_version" {
  value = data.capi_provider_components.tinkerbell.kinds["TinkerbellMachineTemplate"].api_version
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Provider name as clusterctl knows it (`tinkerbell`, `talos`, `kubeadm`, ...).
- `type` (String) Provider type: `core`, `infrastructure`, `bootstrap`, `control_plane`, `ipam` or `addon`.

### Optional

- `core_contract` (String) Core API version the provider's kinds are resolved against, the way the installed core provider would (`v1beta2`). Defaults to the contract the release declares.
- `fetch_config` (Attributes) Where the components come from, as on a `capi_cluster` provider entry: `owner`/`repository` build a GitHub releases URL, `url` or `oci` are used verbatim. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--fetch_config))
- `version` (String) Release tag (`v0.7.9`). Omitted means the repository's latest, which needs a GitHub API call.

### Read-Only

- `contract` (String) CAPI contract the release implements, from its metadata.
- `kinds` (Attributes Map) Every CRD kind the release ships, keyed by kind name (`TinkerbellMachineTemplate`), at the API version objects of it should use. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--kinds))
- `resolved_version` (String) The release that was fetched.
- `url` (String) Resolved components URL.

<a id="nestedatt--fetch_config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `fetch_config`

Optional:

- `oci` (String) Verbatim OCI reference.
- `owner` (String) GitHub owner.
- `repository` (String) GitHub repository.
- `url` (String) Verbatim clusterctl components URL.


<a id="nestedatt--kinds"></a>
### Nested Schema for `kinds`

Read-Only:

- `api_version` (String) `group/version`.
- `group` (String) API group.
- `kind` (String) Kind.
- `version` (String) API version.
